fact: Answering oral questions in the National Assembly on Thursday 18 June 2026, the Minister of the Interior said that 238 local identification and census committees had been formed in every commune since the end of September 2025, that entry in the National Population Register is now a permanent service at the competent centres rather than a campaign, that 36,516 citizens had been registered in under a year under the mechanisms of the 2025 legal reform, and that the register had grown from 3.4 million citizens in 2019 to more than 5.1 million; a deputy said the July 2025 ministerial decision on registration procedures had been slow to take effect.
title: وزير الداخلية: التقييد السكاني أصبح خدمة عمومية دائمة تضمن حق جميع المواطنين في التسجيل
